provenance.method: Exact QANTA upstream answer labels preserved from gold_label.expected_answer; the checked-in dev source was used to verify promoted dev labels.

limitations: These labels are authoritative for the QANTA upstream dataset, not a claim that quiz-bowl tournament organizers officially published them.
Bracketed accept, prompt, and reject instructions are preserved inside the upstream answer label; no aliases or normalization rules are added.
The checked-in raw dataset contains the dev split only; only the subsampled promoted benchmark.json is retained in-tree.
